newsitem.title: HUNGARY: ICN to receive Alkaloida stake on Oct 10.
newsitem.headline: ICN to receive Alkaloida stake on Oct 10.

text.p: The U.S.'s ICN Pharmaceuticals Inc will receive next week the 50.02 percent stake it had acquired in Hungarian pharmaceuticals firm Alkaloida Vegyeszeti Gyar Rt, the privatisation agency APV Rt said on Thursday.
"According to a share purchase deal struck between APV Rt and ICN Pharmaceuticals Inc, ICN will receive the share package of 2.431 billion forint face value on October 10," APV said.

Within 90 days after receiving the stake ICN will implement a capital increase, bringing Alkaloida's current share capital of 4.86 billion forints by 1.8 billion, to be paid by cash in one instalment, it said.
As a result of the increase APV's stake will go down to 25 percent plus one share stake.

In parallel with the new majority shareholder's capital raise, Alkaloida will issue new employees shares, it said. In late June APV said employees will be offered a nominal 300 million forints share package.
The privatisation agency announced a one-round public tender for the 50.02 percent stake of Alkaloida on April 2 and declared ICN as winner in June.
